mobbin:78ae405b-2c59-46f6-94bc-933c189d2.summary: From Help, the user picks a recently scanned product, chooses an issue category, selects which fields are wrong, writes a note, attaches a mandatory photo (camera or library), and gets a thank-you + 48h follow-up confirmation.
steps: Help — recent scanned products + general problem list
Product context — What's the issue? categories
Correct a product — pick incorrect fields (Next disabled)
Detail form — empty note + Add a photo Mandatory (Send disabled)
Note filled — Missing ingredients; photo still required
Action sheet — Take a picture / Photo library
Thank you alert — message sent, reply within 48 hours
steal: Recent scans as reporting shortcuts with thumb + relative time (step 1)—jump to the item you just touched.
Keep scanned-item header (photo/name/status/age) while picking issue type (steps 2, 8).
Mandatory photo badge + disabled Send until evidence attached (steps 5–7).
Camera vs library action sheet with Take a picture first (step 7); closed-loop Thank you + SLA (step 8).
avoid: Deep multi-step wizard (issue → field pick → note → photo) for a gloved sim-tech flag—too many screens for missing/broken on a pre-session walk.
mobbin:78ae405b-2c59-46f6-94bc-933c189d2.fit: Fits equipment-check analog: starts from a scanned item, issue categories, mandatory photo—not a room QR checklist or tick-all walkthrough; mobile beats SRV because tech is at the broken gear; extend Baseline sim-tech setup with item-level flag + evidence handoff.
